blocks.heading: Six Real Tracks, At a Glance
rows: Private consulting firms, preparing Environmental Impact Assessment reports for infrastructure, mining, and industrial projects
M.Sc Environmental Science plus familiarity with MoEFCC clearance procedures
Central and State Pollution Control Boards (CPCB/SPCB), Forest Department, MoEFCC
Listed companies' sustainability teams, ESG advisory arms of consulting firms
Environmental science or engineering background plus an ESG/sustainability-reporting certification
Wildlife and conservation NGOs, forest research institutes
B.Sc/M.Sc Environmental Science or Wildlife Biology, often with fieldwork experience
Solar/wind developers, carbon-credit verification and advisory firms
Environmental science or engineering degree plus project-specific compliance experience
M.Sc plus a PhD for the senior rungs, the same government/academic research ladder as most pure-science tracks

blocks.heading: Real Pay, Track By Track
rows: Follows the standard state or central government pay scale for the specific post
Roughly Rs 6-12 LPA entry, rising to Rs 18-30+ LPA at head-of-sustainability level in a large listed company
Roughly Rs 2.5-5 LPA, usually project-funded rather than a fixed annual package
Roughly Rs 5-10 LPA entry, tracking closer to infrastructure-sector pay than traditional environmental-science pay
